paragraphs.text: Krysalthus (kris-AL-thus) is a forest in Stonehaven , the western part of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .

Krysalthus is an enchanted forest south of the Plains of Ephren , and north of Arathoxia . It was controlled by House Verdenth , the seat of Emerald Magic, led by Lady Verdenth until her death. Krysalthus is home to the Ironroot Treefolk and all manner of woodland creatures.
The Shadow Mage , vol. 2 erroneously refers to the location as "Krysilthas" (kris-IL-thas).
